readOnly: Lead Awaker manages these settings for you. Ask your contact at Lead Awaker to change them.
notConfigured: Recaps and alerts are not set up for this account yet. Add a recipient or change any setting to switch the daily recap on.

recap.title: Daily recap
recap.help: One message a day with the calls, chats and bookings, and what is waiting on the team. Nothing is sent on a day without activity.
recap.enabledHelp: Sent once a day at the time below, in the account's timezone.

channels.crmHelpRecap: A notification for the client's own users in Lead Awaker.
channels.emailHelpRecap: The full recap with names and times, to every email recipient.
channels.whatsappHelpRecap: The day's numbers and a button, sent from Lead Awaker's WhatsApp number.
channels.crmHelpAlerts: A notification for the client's users and the Lead Awaker team.
channels.emailHelpAlerts: Every detail of the event, to every email recipient.
channels.whatsappHelpAlerts: A short message with a button, sent from Lead Awaker's WhatsApp number.

instant.title: Instant alerts
instant.help: Sent the moment something happens that cannot wait for the daily recap.
instant.includePhone: Show the caller's number in WhatsApp
instant.includePhoneHelp: So the team can call back straight from the message. Off: the number is only in Lead Awaker and the email.

appointment_booked.label: New appointment
appointment_booked.help: A customer booked through the phone, a chat or the booking page.

appointment_rescheduled.label: Appointment moved
appointment_rescheduled.help: A customer moved their appointment to another time.

appointment_cancelled.label: Appointment cancelled
appointment_cancelled.help: Only when the customer cancelled, not when the team did.

callback_requested.label: Callback request
callback_requested.help: A caller asked for a call back, left a message, or a transfer was not picked up.

lead_needs_reply.label: Reply needed
lead_needs_reply.help: The assistant paused a chat and a person needs to answer. At most once per customer per day.

new_photo.label: New photo
new_photo.help: A customer sent a photo in WhatsApp or the website chat, with what it shows. By email (photo attached) and in the CRM, not by WhatsApp.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.help: WhatsApp alerts raised in these hours are sent when they end. Email and the CRM are never held.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.help: Who gets the recaps and alerts. A name is needed for WhatsApp, it opens every message.
recipients.name: Name
recipients.consent: Agreed to receive WhatsApp updates from Lead Awaker
recipients.resubscribe: They asked to get updates again
recipients.badEmail: One of the email addresses is not valid.
recipients.nameRequired: Every WhatsApp number needs a name.
recipients.saveFailed: Could not save the recipients. Check the numbers and try again.
